text:
An adaptive fighter who chooses a specialization at Floor 2 (Beast/Ironscale/Tempest, via the Spirit Guide). This test NPC lets you pick which specialization to test directly - all 3 are now built.

Primary: STR | Secondary: CON

MP mechanic: MP = Chi, builds from hitting mobs and Meditate - never decays.

Shared foundation (all specializations):
Tiger Strike - fast primary punch
Roundhouse Kick - frontal AoE kick
Valkor's Fervor - damage buff + double Chi generation
Meditate - evolving Chi restore + spell damage buff
Martial Form - evolving transformation into your chosen specialization's form

Beast (werewolf, Fighter/DPS):
Alpha Strike - evolving multi-target blink combo, ends behind the final target
Howling Sequence - evolving rapid multi-hit claw combo
Perfect Form - evolving Attack Speed buff
Break - target takes increased damage
Predator's Pounce (Wolf Fang) - heavy strike that stuns
Blood Sacrifice (Kelberoth Strike) - sacrifice Health for massive damage
Traverse Punch - dash behind the target and strike
Passives: Bone Memory, Survival Instinct, Feral Hunger

Ironscale (lizardman, Tank):
Iron Body - evolving immobile defensive cooldown, reflects damage
Pressure Point - evolving weak-point debuff, becomes a raid-wide mark
Shockwave - evolving AoE threat + control
Counter Strike - negate and counter the next hit
Perfect Counter - reflect the next incoming attack in full
Taunt - force nearby enemies to attack you
Anchor Hold - root an enemy in place
Passives: Elemental Defense, Bedrock, Living Fortress

Tempest (harpy, Ranged DPS):
Hail of Feathers - evolving AoE feather storm
Void Palm - evolving ranged palm strike
Tempest Focus - evolving attack/cast/movement speed buff
Star Cross - fire chi stars at multiple nearby enemies
Chi Bullet - piercing shot that detonates on impact
Flickering Step - instant reposition, leaves an afterimage
Feather Prison - root an enemy in place
Passives: Flowing Chi, Perfect Rhythm, One with the Wind
